title: Color Contrast (Minimum)
description: Text must have sufficient contrast against its background to be readable by people with low vision.
requirement: Normal text requires 4.5:1 contrast ratio. Large text (18px+ regular or 14px+ bold) requires 3:1.
how_to_check: Use a contrast checker tool (e.g., WebAIM Contrast Checker). Compare the text color against its direct background color. Check all states: default, hover, focus, disabled.
common_violations: Light gray text on white backgrounds
Placeholder text with insufficient contrast
Disabled state text that is too faint to read
Colored text on colored backgrounds (e.g., white on light blue)

title: Non-text Contrast
description: UI components and meaningful graphics must have sufficient contrast to be perceivable.
requirement: UI component boundaries and states require 3:1 contrast against adjacent colors. Includes borders, icons, focus indicators.
how_to_check: Check input borders against background (3:1). Check icons against background (3:1). Check focus ring visibility. Check checkbox/radio borders.
common_violations: Light input borders that disappear on white backgrounds
Low-contrast icons in disabled states
Focus indicators that blend into the background
Chart elements without sufficient contrast

title: Target Size (Minimum)
description: Interactive elements must be large enough for users to activate reliably, especially on touch devices.
requirement: Minimum 44x44 CSS pixels for touch targets. Smaller elements need adequate spacing to meet effective target size.
how_to_check: Measure the clickable/tappable area of each interactive element. Include padding in the measurement. Check that closely spaced targets don't overlap.
common_violations: Small icon buttons without adequate padding (e.g., 24x24px)
Close buttons in corners that are too small
Dense lists of links or buttons with tiny tap targets
Checkbox/radio inputs without clickable label area

title: Focus Visible
description: All interactive elements must show a visible focus indicator when navigated via keyboard.
requirement: Focus indicator must be visible and distinguishable. Should have at least 3:1 contrast. Never remove outline without providing an alternative.
how_to_check: Tab through all interactive elements. Verify each shows a clear focus ring or border change. Check that custom focus styles are visible in both light and dark mode.
common_violations: Using outline:none or outline:0 without a replacement
Focus rings that are invisible on certain backgrounds
Custom components that don't receive or show focus
Modal content that cannot be focused or tabbed through

title: Name, Role, Value
description: All UI components must have an accessible name, role, and current state that can be programmatically determined.
requirement: Use semantic HTML elements. Add ARIA roles/attributes for custom widgets. Ensure state changes (checked, expanded, selected) are communicated.
how_to_check: Inspect elements with browser dev tools accessibility panel. Verify accessible name is present and descriptive. Check that role matches the component behavior. Test with a screen reader.
common_violations: Icon buttons missing aria-label
Custom dropdowns without listbox/combobox roles
Toggle switches without aria-checked state
Dynamic content changes not announced via aria-live

title: Error Identification
description: When an input error is detected, the item in error must be identified and the error described in text.
requirement: Show specific error messages (not just red borders). Identify which field has the error. Describe what went wrong and how to fix it.
how_to_check: Trigger validation errors on each form field. Verify error messages appear in text (not just color change). Check that error messages are linked to inputs via aria-describedby.
common_violations: Only changing border color to red without error text
Generic error messages like 'Invalid input'
Error messages not associated with their input field
Errors only shown on form submit, not inline

title: Labels or Instructions
description: Form inputs must have labels or instructions so users know what data is expected.
requirement: Every input needs a visible label. Use placeholder text as a supplement, never a replacement. Indicate required fields. Provide format hints for complex inputs.
how_to_check: Verify each form input has a visible <label> element associated via for/id or wrapping. Check that required fields are indicated. Check that format expectations are communicated.
common_violations: Inputs with placeholder text but no visible label
Labels that disappear on focus (floating label pattern without fallback)
Required fields not indicated visually or programmatically
Date/phone inputs without format hints

title: Keyboard Accessible
description: All functionality must be operable through a keyboard interface without requiring specific timings.
requirement: All interactive elements must be focusable and activatable via keyboard. Tab for navigation, Enter/Space for activation, Arrow keys for within-widget navigation, Escape to close.
how_to_check: Unplug your mouse and navigate the entire interface using only keyboard. Verify all actions can be performed. Check for keyboard traps (can you always Tab out).
common_violations: Click-only handlers without keyboard equivalents
Custom dropdowns that don't respond to arrow keys
Modals that don't trap focus or allow Escape to close
Drag-and-drop without keyboard alternative

title: Use of Color
description: Color must not be the only visual means of conveying information, indicating actions, or distinguishing elements.
requirement: Supplement color with icons, text, patterns, or other visual indicators. Error states need icons + color. Links need underline or other non-color indicator.
how_to_check: View the interface in grayscale. Can you still understand all information? Check error/warning/success states for non-color indicators. Check links for underlines.
common_violations: Error states indicated only by red border (no icon or text)
Success/failure shown only with green/red colors
Links distinguished from body text only by color
Chart data series differentiated only by color

title: Reflow
description: Content must be presentable without loss of information or functionality when reflowed at different viewport widths.
requirement: Content must reflow without horizontal scrolling at 320px width. No fixed-width layouts that cause overflow. Use responsive techniques.
how_to_check: Resize browser to 320px width. Verify no horizontal scrollbar appears. Check that all content is still accessible. Verify text wraps properly.
common_violations: Fixed-width tables that overflow on narrow screens
Horizontal navigation that doesn't collapse
Images or embeds that don't scale down
Absolute positioning that causes overlap at small widths
